description: Defines the RocketDataSelect class, a custom UI element for data selection in the game, extending Rml::ElementFormControlDataSelect and Rml::EventListener, with event handling and data source management.

classes.name: RocketDataSelect
classes.description: A custom UI element for data selection, handling attribute changes and events to synchronize with data sources.

methods.name: RocketDataSelect
methods.description: Constructor initializing the data select element with a tag.

methods.name: OnChildAdd
methods.description: Handles addition of child elements, sets owner and registers show event listener.

methods.name: OnChildRemove
methods.description: Handles removal of child elements, unregisters show event listener.

methods.name: OnAttributeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to attributes, particularly 'source', to set data source and table names.

methods.name: ProcessEvent
methods.description: Processes show and change events to initialize selection and dispatch data source change events.
